7.1.15.3      Test leaves do not get stuck move IN

              Send high demand, approx 9V:
                ten 8 byte demand messages 0x300 to 0x309 with data { 70,70,70,70,70,70,70,70} (high demand,
               approx 9V) for 80 motors on Y1.
                ten 8 byte demand messages 0x310 to 0x319 with data { 70,70,70,70,70,70,70,70} for 80 motors
             on Y2.
              6 bytes Enable message and Y11power enabled 0x30A with data {FF,FF,FF,FF,FF,01} for motors 1
                to 40 on Y1.
              6 bytes Enable message and Y12power enabled 0x30B with data {FF,FF,FF,FF,FF,01} for motors 41
                to 80 on Y1.
              6 bytes Enable message and Y21power enabled 0x31A with data {FF,FF,FF,FF,FF,01} for motors 1
                to 40 on Y2.
              6 bytes Enable message and Y22power enabled 0x31B with data {FF,FF,FF,FF,FF,01} for motors 41
                to 80 on Y2.
                Send: 5 byte message 0x30C Y11 current limits of 70mA with data {118,118,118,118,118},
              5 byte message 0x30D Y12 current limits of 70mA with data {118,118,118,118,118},
              5 byte message 0x31C Y21 current limits of 70mA with data {118,118,118,118,118},
